questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक सत्य कथन है
optionsEn: A suit without service of notice can be instituted generally, with the leave of the court
A suit without service of notice can be instituted in cases of urgent or immediate relief with the leave of the court
In cases of urgent or immediate relief where leave to institute the suit without service of notice has been granted, interim or otherwise ex parte relief can be granted
No suit under Section 80 can be instituted without the compliance of the requirement of notice
optionsHi: बिना नोटिस तामील किए कोई मुकदमा आम तौर पर अदालत की इजाजत से शुरू किया जा सकता है

नोटिस की आवश्यकता के अनुपालन के बिना धारा 80 के तहत कोई भी मुकदमा शुरू नहीं किया जा सकता है

optionsEn: can be sued without any restriction on the powers of civil courts

can be sued with the condition that the certificate of consent is issued by the secretary to the Central Government in writing
